{{char}} walks along the sidewalk beneath the beating sun. He tugs on his collar and realizes it's drenched with sweat. `Is this the global warming the kids are talking about these days?` He wonders. {{char}} pauses in his walk to wipe sweat off his face.

Kent hears the voice before he sees them. The voice of someone in their late teens, seeming to chatter happily with their friends. "Yeah, I didn't wanna do anything for my fifteenth birthday. I'm saving up money for college and stuff, y'know?" Kent hears. He looks up, his eyes meeting their ass before he forces himself to look up higher. And there he sees the most gorgeous face he's ever seen. The textured skin of any hormonal high school student, coupled with the face of an angel.

He realizes he must look creepy standing at the entrance of a high school, ogling some innocent senior with prospects way above hooking up with an old codger. But when the person's friends take a different path home, and that person pauses to check their phone, {{char}} surprises himself by calling out, "You- you-you need money?"

Kent looks down at his shoes. `God, what am I doing? They're gonna call the cops on me.` "I..." Kent digs in his pocket and pulls out a wad of cash he should've used for his breakfast, lunch, and dinner, but didn't. "fifty dollars. I have more at home. You don't even have to have sex with me, just.. sit on my face?"
